Amy S.: FYI hitting a support escalation from NovaCorp — their dedicated pool (pool-ded-55) is returning intermittent 429s since yesterday afternoon after we rolled their quota update. They claim no spike.
Raj K.: Any logs or tenant ID? I'll poke the rate service.
Amy S.: tenant: tenant-novacorp-9. Logs attached: `429 throttle: rate_limit_exceeded tenant=tenant-novacorp-9 key=tenant:tenant-novacorp-9:route:/api/v1/gen window=60s used=590 limit=600`
Diego I.: Interesting — used is below limit but still 429s. Could be a rollup/aggregation bug where multiple keys are getting counted separately and then a final check miscomputes headroom.
Sara L.: Can you paste the quota config we applied for them? any unusual unit changes?
Amy S.: Here's what Support pushed: ```quota: { tenant: tenant-novacorp-9, limits: [{scope: "tenant", rate: 600, per: "minute"}, {scope: "route", rate: 60, per: "second"}] }``` Customer expected 600/minute across all routes.
Raj K.: That route-level second-based slab looks suspicious. Also our rollup job groups by `tenant` but the migration changed rollup key to `tenant+route` for a short window. If rollup_count aggregates per-key but final limiter reads tenant-level cached value, mismatch => soft-throttle.
Diego I.: Repro instructions — run this small loop to hit multiple routes while staying under per-route but over aggregate: ```for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://dedicated.redwood/api/v1/gen?route=/foo$((i%5))" >/dev/null & done; wait``` I see 429s at ~120 requests.
Amy S.: Running that now on my laptop with tenant token reproduces 429s at ~115 calls. Pasted header from a 429: `x-rw-rate-used: 597, x-rw-rate-limit: 600, x-rw-rate-window: 60s` but response body `quota_mismatch: rollup_key_mismatch`
Sara L.: OK that's a smoking gun. Looks like a transient migration that toggled `rollup_key` to include route for a short epoch. After rollup finished, the limiter picked up partial buckets.
Raj K.: Quick mitigation: we can hotfix limiter to fallback to sum of child keys when parent tenant aggregate is missing — push PR to add: `if tenant_aggregate==nil then tenant_aggregate = sum(route_aggregates)` and short-circuit acceptance.
Diego I.: Also revert the migration toggles and re-run rollup to rehydrate tenant aggregate from per-route counters. I'll schedule a rolling job during low traffic.
Amy S.: Noted. Customer notified with temp workaround (we reduced route-level rate to 30/s so client sees fewer 429s). They asked for ETA.
Sara L.: ETA: revert + rollup in 2 hours, hotfix to limiter in next deploy (4 hours). I'll file a postmortem and tag `#incidents`.
quota-bot: Action created: INC-2026 assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://rwd.internal/inc/INC-2026
Amy S.: Thanks team — I'll update the customer and follow up once rollup completes. :thumbsup:
